This page answers one question: **can we actually see the thing people are arguing about?**

If we cannot see it, we say so. We do not fill the hole with a story.

[This week's brief](articles/weekly-brief-2026-w35.qmd) · [Claim register](articles/book-one-coupling-register.qmd) · [Current gates (full table)](https://github.com/William-Edgar-Brissey/project-register/blob/main/gods_eye/CURRENT_GATES.md)

## Right now

**Rain.** Thirty years of monthly rain at nine places (Ubay, Manaus, Lagos, Nairobi, Jakarta, Mumbai, Mexico City, São Paulo, Paris). Sample, not the planet. Newest CHIRPS month on the public server: **July 2026**. August is late, not “no rain.”

**Heat.** Same nine places, ERA5. Useful for “is this July odd *here*?” Useless as a world average.

**Earthquakes.** Global M4.5+ counts, 1991–2020, tropics vs the rest. Background rate, not this week's shaking at your house.

**Fire.** One NOAA-20 pass on 30 August 2026: about **5,000** hotspots. One western-southern box empty while another had thousands. Empty = blind, not safe.

**Pacific heat index (ONI).** May–July 2026: **+1.39** ([CPC file](https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/data/indices/oni.ascii.txt)). One ocean product. Not your town forecast.

## Currents — what is actually watched

The ocean is not one conveyor with one number.

**Atlantic overturning (AMOC at 26°N).** RAPID’s last full public series runs through **February 2024**. That tile is **STALE**. We will not print a 2026 Sverdrup. Other Atlantic lines (OSNAP, MOVE, SAMBA) exist and are also delayed or partial. None of them is “off”; they are slow.

**Global surface drift (top ~30 m).** OSCAR v2 is a near-real-time satellite product (~2-day lag). It can show whether the *skin* of the ocean is slack or racing. It cannot say the deep conveyor collapsed. **We have not ingested OSCAR into the weekly job yet.** State: registered, fetch pending.

**Other named currents.** Agulhas, Indonesian Throughflow, Antarctic Circumpolar, Kuroshio, Brazil Current, equatorial undercurrents: scientists monitor them with arrays, ships, and altimetry. **They are not on this board.** That is our gap, not proof they are unwatched. Full list: [CURRENT_GATES.md](https://github.com/William-Edgar-Brissey/project-register/blob/main/gods_eye/CURRENT_GATES.md).

Do not read rain in Ubay as “the AMOC.” Do not read a missing Sv as collapse.

**Volcanic winter / food-web collapse / “move south.”** Parked or unsupported by these gauges. Off this page.

## How to use this

1. Your national weather and fire service first.
2. Compare a month to the **same month** in a long record, not to another continent.
3. Empty box or late file = missing, not calm.

Advice. Not an order.
